title: End User Path
description: Suitable for Sales, HR, and Accounting professionals. Focused on navigating Odoo and executing daily business workflows efficiently.

title: System Admin Path
description: For IT staff responsible for keeping an existing instance secure, backed up, and upgraded.

title: Implementer Path
description: For consultants and analysts responsible for configuring Odoo for clients end to end.

title: Developer Path
description: For engineers extending Odoo with custom modules and integrations.

title: Automation Specialist Path
description: For teams automating repetitive workflows across Odoo with rules, triggers, and integrations.
